courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 大型玻璃肋結構安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」與「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大型玻璃肋結構安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Unit load path and anchor reactions" and "Performance mock-up and racking test" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural glass-fin installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位；大型玻璃肋結構安裝則以以玻璃肋的面內彎曲、側向扭轉挫屈、膠合中間膜耦合與破損後承載，控制全玻璃立面的設計、吊裝與驗收為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure; Structural glass-fin installation centres on in-plane bending, lateral–torsional buckling, interlayer coupling and post-breakage capacity that govern the design, lifting and acceptance of all-glass façades, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓板邊緣錨件反力」與「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大型玻璃肋結構安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” and “Fin tributary wind load”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural glass-fin installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” and “Wind-driven water head”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
history.text: 單元式帷幕牆把立面的玻璃、框料與密封移到工廠組裝，隨著超高層建築的興起成為主流做法，因為它減少高空作業、縮短工期並讓品質在可控環境下完成。2010 年完工的哈里發塔高 828 m，官方資料記錄其鋁與玻璃立面在 512 m 高度安裝的紀錄；2014 年完工的紐約世界貿易中心一號大樓由 Benson Industries 承作帷幕牆；倫敦碎片大廈則以約 11,000 片玻璃覆蓋 95 層的錐形塔身。歐洲以 EN 13830 規範帷幕牆產品性能，英國 CWCT 與美國 AAMA 則建立了樣品牆試驗與層間位移試驗的方法。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Unitized curtain walls move glazing, framing and sealing into the factory, and they became the dominant approach as supertall buildings multiplied because they reduce work at height, shorten programmes and let quality be achieved in controlled conditions. Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010 at 828 m, records in its official information the installation of its aluminium and glass façade at a height of 512 m; One World Trade Center in New York, completed in 2014, had its curtain wall delivered by Benson Industries; and The Shard in London covers its 95-storey tapering form with about 11,000 glass panels. In Europe EN 13830 governs curtain-wall product performance, while CWCT in the UK and AAMA in the US established methods for mock-up and racking tests. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
